title: Scene (v1)
description: Root scene document. Engine- and product-independent: no Unity/Unreal fields, and no knowledge of what is being scanned, stored, or organized (that belongs to the application consuming this schema, e.g. vroom-sync).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document conforms to. Bump per the versioning/migration rules in this repo's README.

origin.description: This scene's transform relative to whatever shared parent frame the caller composes it within (e.g. when several scenes were captured in one continuous, spatially-consistent session and need to be stitched back together). Composing `origin` with an object's own `transform` places that object in the parent frame. Identity (zero position, no rotation) if this scene stands alone or has not yet been aligned to a parent frame. The schema makes no assumption about what that parent frame represents — that meaning is defined by whatever application organizes scenes, not by this schema.
